items.name: 暮色街角
items.scene: An inviting quiet European-inspired urban lane at blue hour after rain, brick facades, warm small shop windows, restrained brass wall lamps and stone paving, distant city roofs. No busy storefront clutter. Clear dry-standing pavement in middle foreground; architecture frames a welcoming central walkway. Warm amber lighting balanced with violet-blue sky.
items.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: reusable empty background for a fictional Live2D character scene.
Primary request: ONE complete high-quality anime environment illustration, wide landscape 16:9 composition, ideally 1920x1080 or higher. This is a finished bitmap background, not a screenshot, mockup or collage.
Scene/backdrop: An inviting quiet European-inspired urban lane at blue hour after rain, brick facades, warm small shop windows, restrained brass wall lamps and stone paving, distant city roofs. No busy storefront clutter. Clear dry-standing pavement in middle foreground; architecture frames a welcoming central walkway. Warm amber lighting balanced with violet-blue sky.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted anime visual-novel background, refined clear linework, restrained painterly materials, beautiful coherent lighting and believable environmental depth. Match the rendering finish of elegant anime character-scene illustrations, but absolutely NO character.
Composition/framing: stable eye-level camera around 1.4 metres high, moderate natural perspective, straight vertical architecture. Clear middle foreground footing and a quiet central 40 percent intended for overlaying a full-body Live2D character. Background details must still make sense through the central vertical crop used on a phone. Put most stronger environmental accents and furniture toward the sides. Keep foreground contrast controlled without a fake vignette or dark overlay. Do not draw a placeholder for the character.
Constraints: entirely unoccupied scene; no people, faces, human silhouettes, mannequins, animals, statues shaped like people, portraits, reflections of people, character shadows, posters, readable letters, signage, logos or watermarks. No UI, decorative frame, contact sheet, heavy blur, bokeh blobs or photographic depth-of-field. Single scene filling all edges, clear natural surfaces, no fisheye distortion. Preserve open standing room, no object crossing the central foreground.

items.name: 窗边居室
items.scene: A tasteful comfortable modern apartment living room at early evening, soft upholstered sofa and simple wooden side table at the sides, bookshelf and green plant, large back window showing a calm city skyline. Open floor in center foreground for a standing character, furniture kept out of center. Warm interior lamplight and cool evening exterior, personal but not extravagant.
